meta.name: dms porto + The Agent
meta.description: Tactile cinematographer portfolio and interactive 3D studio workspace calibrated around warm alabaster stone, darkroom cinema charcoal, 2+1 editorial typography, and restrained cobalt telemetry.

primary.role: Primary ink, editorial headlines, high-contrast action fills, and active frame borders

secondary.role: Warm alabaster studio canvas ground across navigation, hero, and portfolio ledger

accent.role: Restrained cobalt telemetry accent for timeline playhead, cut markers, active studio focus rings, and score clips

neutral.usage: Lightest #FFFFFF to #E3E1DB form elevated cards, warm forms, and tab tracks on #ECECE8; #555551 and #3F3F3C provide >= 6.3:1 AA contrast for secondary copy; #18181B..#0B0D13 anchor primary ink, Log-to-Final darkroom cinema band, and Night/3D studio views.

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light dominant on warm alabaster (#ECECE8) paired with inverted high-contrast darkroom band (#111113) and themed 3D studio surfaces (Gallery #ECECE8, Night #0B0D13, Pecel Lele Dusk #171828, Hologram #03060D)

font_families.heading: Plus Jakarta Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
font_families.body: Plus Jakarta Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: Crisp geometric sans (Plus Jakarta Sans) for UI and portfolio headlines, paired with JetBrains Mono (tabular-nums) for timecodes, frame rates, and section indices (01..05), plus Cormorant Garamond reserved as the single editorial serif accent inside The Agent studio.

spacing.section_rhythm: Alternating macro structural bands (alabaster rounded hero -> warm stone works -> darkroom #111113 color science -> warm stone cut timeline & practice ledger -> crisp white rounded contact band) separated by 01..05 hairline section indices.

layout.grid_system: 12-column responsive editorial grid for desktop bento showcase and NLE inspector, collapsing to crisp single-column tap lists and bottom-sheet flows on mobile.

shape.divider_style: 1px hairline dividers (#DCDAD3 light / #27272A darkroom / #3B334D street dusk) pairing monospace numeric prefixes with full-width horizontal rules.

iconography.style: Minimalist architectural 1.5px-2px outline icons paired with crisp filled playheads.

motion.entrance_pattern: Staggered upward glide (14px-22px) synchronized between GSAP timelines, Lenis scroll ticker, and Framer Motion spring/cubic primitives.
motion.exit_pattern: Clean fast fade with subtle 4px-8px elevation shift.

components.button_style: Solid dark ink (#18181B) and bordered ivory pill buttons (rounded-full) for primary actions; subtly rounded 10px-12px buttons for technical NLE controls and spatial agent triggers.
components.input_style: 44px minimum height, 12px radius, crisp 1px #D5D3CC border with #18181B or cobalt #2563EB focus ring.
components.card_style: Clean 1px bordered pure white or #F7F6F2 cards with zero competing border accents and clean internal typographic hierarchy.
components.navigation_pattern: Sticky alabaster header with slash-separated text links on desktop and fixed 4-tab thumb-zone bar on mobile.
components.modal_style: Responsive full-media film lightbox dialog on desktop and pull-up booking sheet on mobile.
components.list_style: Clean hairline-separated ledger rows for capabilities and mobile filmography tap list.
components.component_notes: All controls maintain single-line non-wrapping labels and >= 44px touch targets on mobile.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A physical director's cut-sheet and tabletop architectural studio stage where paper grain, Log film stock, and calibrated 3D desk craft coexist.
aesthetic.era_influence: Modern Swiss editorial grid meets contemporary cinema NLE suite.
aesthetic.genre: Director of Photography & Post-Production Studio Portfolio + 3D Agent Workspace

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous breathing room framing asymmetric studio practice columns and above/below the 3D studio stage with zero viewport occlusion.
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Top-heavy editorial clarity in hero transitioning into balanced bento frames, heavy high-contrast #111113 darkroom color stage, and airy white closing brief.
visual_language.contrast_level: High contrast primary ink on warm stone (15.1:1) and crisp light typography on cinema charcoal.
visual_language.texture_usage: Micro SVG fractal film grain (3.2% multiply) plus procedural wood, plaster, terpal, and wet-asphalt PBR textures in the 3D stage.

composition.flow_direction: Vertical multi-band scroll progression across chapters 01..05 paired with horizontal scrub sliders and isometric 3D spatial depth.
composition.grouping_strategy: Bordered segmented tracks for filters and hairline rules dividing technical metadata rows.
composition.negative_space_role: Structural resting frame keeping cinema stills, NLE tracks, and 3D character pins uncluttered.

imagery.photo_treatment: Natural 16:9 / 4:3 widescreen framing with hover viewfinder corner reticles and optional ungraded Log CSS curve simulation.
imagery.illustration_style: Low-poly architectural miniature props, halftone-free painted street banners, and fallback pixel sprite storyboards.
imagery.graphic_elements: Optical viewfinder corner ticks, NLE playhead diamond markers, and spatial 3D character anchors.
imagery.pattern_usage: Subtle SVG fractal grain and wet-asphalt specular roughness variation without noisy background patterns.

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Tactile detent taps, subtle WebAudio procedural clicks/whooshes synced to mute state, and crisp magnetic cursor pull on desktop.
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Gentle 3px elevation lift, optical corner reticles, contextual label cursor, and spatial agent tooltip cards.
interaction_feel.loading_style: Choreographed alabaster-to-dark-curtain AccessModeGate reveal with instant skip/replay support.
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: Targeted feedback on interactive cinema cards, scrub handles, NLE clips, and 3D studio controls without visual noise.

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: Direct, studio-practical, Bilingual technical clarity (English portfolio copy paired with Bahasa Indonesia agent studio controls).
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Helpful contextual status prompts guiding click or arrow-key exploration.
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Clear inline validation hints without jarring alerts.

background_effects.description: Desktop-only static SVG feTurbulence film-grain overlay at 3.2% multiply opacity plus smooth Lenis scroll integration.

particle_systems.description: Hologram mode streams 150 additive cyan data particles smoothly from workstation screens along parabolic arcs to the Mission Board.

params.spawn_area: agent desk screens to mission board

3d_elements.description: Isometric 3D agent studio supporting Asli, Voxel, Hologram, Diorama, and Pecel Lele street-stall PBR style kits with autonomous Mission Board dispatching and GSAP camera focus.

params.lighting: Hemisphere sky/ground bounce + shadow-casting sun key + Pecel Lele nocturnal warm stall lamps
params.camera: PerspectiveCamera 34deg FOV with GSAP spherical orbit proxy and non-fighting pointer drag
params.materials: Calibrated MeshPhysicalMaterial (clearcoat glass/ceramic, velvet sheen, brushed anisotropic metal) and MeshStandardMaterial
params.geometry: Modular architectural furniture, articulated 6-agent rigs, street awning, wooden dining stall
params.interaction_model: Raycasting click/hover + keyboard arrow focus + drag orbit + double-click reset

shader_effects.description: Standard Three.js PBR shaders and ACES Filmic tone mapping without custom GLSL post-processing passes.

parallax.depth_range: scale 1->1.055 and y 0->-14px on desktop showreel
parallax.speed_curve: Lenis smooth wheel scrubbed via GSAP ScrollTrigger

scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: triggered once on enter; scrub on hero showreel media

scroll_morphing.description: Disabled in favor of disciplined section continuity.

text_effects.description: Hero headline animates word-by-word via GSAP staggered reveal immediately upon gate dismissal.

cursor_effects.description: Desktop-only spring-damped editorial cursor pill over [data-cursor] cards plus subtle magnetic pull on hero and contact CTA buttons.

image_effects.description: Interactive Log-to-Final clip-path comparison slider with CSS .grade-log-profile curve and scroll-velocity micro-scale on work cards.
image_effects.technology: CSS clip-path + CSS filter + Framer Motion useVelocity

params.border_treatment: 1px solid architectural borders; zero blur over WebGL stage

canvas_drawings.description: Procedural 2D CanvasTextures generating wood grain, plaster stipple, striped terpal, painted street banners, chalkboard headers, and wet-asphalt roughness puddles.

params.color_scheme: warm timber, terracotta terpal, chalk slate, neutral asphalt

svg_animations.description: Static lucide-react outline icons and subtle CSS opacity scroll indicators without SMIL path morphing.

visual_effects.composite_notes: Heavy WebGL effects stay strictly isolated inside The Agent viewport with automatic 2D pixel sprite grid fallback when WebGL is unavailable, while CSS @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), Framer MotionConfig, and GSAP matchMedia coordinate full motion reduction globally.
